headline: Executive order aims to help people cash in U.S. savings bonds they own but have not yet redeemed.
what_it_does: This executive order focuses on getting U.S. savings bonds redeemed, meaning cashed in by their owners. No summary was provided, so the details of what it directs federal agencies to do are not described here. Based on its title, it appears meant to encourage or make it easier for bond owners to collect money owed to them.

who_it_affects.group: People who own or inherited U.S. savings bonds
who_it_affects.how: They may be more likely to learn about and collect money from bonds they have not cashed in.
As the agency that issues savings bonds, it would likely be the main agency carrying out any steps to promote redemption.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 18, 2020; executive orders generally take effect when signed.
